The plastic focus wheel on our training telescope cracked. Please use my attached sketch to make a friendlier six-scallop replacement. The outside diameter is 38 mm; use that as the image scale reference. The shaft is a 6.00 mm D shaft, with 5.20 mm from its flat to the far round surface. Produce the source mesh, repaired printable mesh, support/slicing preview, and P1S 0.4 mm PETG slice package. Keep the shaft opening facing up if it improves the bore. I need a local test transfer receipt after review; do not send anything to a physical printer.
